olevel_requirement: Five (5) 'O' Level NTC/NBC credit passes or TC II merit including English Language, Mathematics, Home Economics, Biology and Chemistry.
direct_entry: (i) NCE merit in Home Economics; (ii) 'A' Level passes in two (2) of Chemistry or any Biology, Botany and Agricultural Science; (iii) ND/HND credit in Home Economics or Food Science or Hotel and Catering Management or any other related programme.

institution_waivers.note: For a three-year degree programme accepts (in addition to UTME requirements) NCE merit in Home Economics, ND lower credit in Fashion and Clothing Management Education or Home Economics or Home and Rural Economics or Hotel and Catering; a University Degree in any discipline plus departmental UTME requirements may be considered for direct entry into a three-year programme. UTME: five 'O' Level credit passes including any two of Home Management, Clothing and Textiles, Food and Nutrition, Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Agricultural Science, Economics, Cosmetology, Garment Making and Catering Craft plus UNN UTME requirements. UTME subjects: Chemistry or Biology plus any two other Science or Social Science subjects like Agricultural Science, Home Economics, Physics, Mathematics, Economics, Commerce and Geography.

Requires two (2) or three (3) merit in NCE including Home Economics plus three (3) or two (2) 'O' Level credit passes in English Language, Biology/Agricultural Science with 'O' Level pass in Chemistry. UTME: 'O' Level pass in Chemistry and credit pass in Biology/Agricultural Science. UTME subjects: Biology/Agricultural Science and any other two Science or Social Science subjects.

Accepts NCE or ND in Home Economics, Catering and Hotel Management, Textile Management and any other relevant subject with minimum merit pass; very good passes in three JUPEB subjects (Chemistry, Biology and one other from Home Economics, Physics, Food & Nutrition, Home Management, Clothing & Textile); three 'A' Level passes in two relevant Science subjects; ND with Distinction in Hotel Management, Tourism, Catering and Hotel Management. UTME: five O/Level credit passes in English Language, Mathematics, Chemistry, Biology/Agricultural Science and one of Economics, Home Economics, Physics, Food & Nutrition/Home Management, Clothing and Textile, Garment Making/Dyeing & Bleaching/Catering Craft Practice. UTME subjects: English Language, Chemistry, Biology/Agricultural Science and one other from Mathematics, Physics, Food & Nutrition, Home Management, Clothing & Textile, Garment Making, Dyeing & Bleaching, Catering Craft Practice.
Requires three (3) 'A' Level passes/NCE in Home Economics; NCE credit in Home Economics including Education.

Direct Entry: NCE in Home Economics with minimum Merit Pass; at least two (2) 'A' Level passes in two of Chemistry, Biology and Agricultural Science; minimum OND/HND upper credit in Home Economics or Food Science or Hotel and Catering Management. UTME: five 'O' Level credit passes or NTC/NBC credits at one sitting or six at two sittings including English Language, Mathematics and other subjects from Food and Nutrition, Home Management, Clothing and Textile, Agricultural Science, Biology, Economics, Health Education and Chemistry; minimum pass in Chemistry or credit in Food and Nutrition, Home Management or Agricultural Science required. UTME subjects: Mathematics and any two from Biology, Agricultural Science, Physics or Chemistry.

Accepts 'A' Level passes/IJMB in two (2) of Chemistry and any of Biology, Botany or Agricultural Science. UTME: five 'O' Level credit passes in Mathematics/English Language/Home Economics, Biology, Geography, Physics/Chemistry; Old Grade II five passes including Arithmetic/English Language/Domestic Science; New Grade II five credit passes including English Language, Mathematics and Home Economics; one Home Economics subject (Foods and Nutrition, Home Management or Textile and Clothing) is required.

Accepts NCE merit/HND/ND lower credit in Fashion and Clothing Management Education or Home Economics or Hotel and Catering or Home and Rural Economics plus the UNN UTME requirements. UTME: five 'O' Level credit passes including English Language and any two of Home Management, Clothing and Textile, Food and Nutrition, Biology, Chemistry, Agricultural Science and Economics. UTME subjects: Chemistry or Biology plus two other Science subjects.
Accepts 'O' Level pass in Chemistry; does not accept application of ND/HND candidates without teaching qualifications.

Accepts NCE merit in Home Economics, A Level passes in two (2) of Chemistry or any Biology, Botany and Agricultural Science, and ND/HND credit in Home Economics or Food Science or Hotel and Catering Management or any other related programme. Requires Five (5) O Level NTC/NBC credit passes or TC II in English Language, Mathematics and any other three subjects from Home Economics/Management, Biology/Agricultural Science, Chemistry, Physics, Food & Nutrition, Economics, Cosmetology, Clothing & Textile/Garment Making, Catering Craft, Health Education/Health Science, Dyeing & Bleaching, Leather Work, Tourism, Jewellery and Basketry. UTME subjects: English Language, Chemistry/Biology and any other two subjects from the O'Level requirements.

Accepts NCE merit or ND/HND upper credit respectively in the relevant programme. UTME: five 'O' Level credit passes in English Language, Mathematics and any three of Biology, Chemistry, Physics, Food and Nutrition, Clothing and Textile, Home Management. UTME subjects: a Social Science subject as the third subject.

Requires NCE in Home Economics with minimum merit pass, OND Home Economics or Food Science in upper credit or any other related courses. UTME: five credits at SSC or equivalent including English Language, Mathematics, Biology, Chemistry and Home Economics or Food Nutrition. UTME subjects: Biology or Agricultural Science or Chemistry, Home Economics or Food and Nutrition and any one of Mathematics and Economics.

Accepts NCE merit in Home Economics, A Level passes in two (2) of Chemistry or any Biology, Botany and Agricultural Science, and ND/HND credit in Home Economics or Food Science or Hotel and Catering Management or related programme. UTME: five O Level credit passes including English Language, Mathematics and any three of Biology/Agric Sc., Home Management, Food and Nutrition, Clothing & Textiles, Economics, Geography, Chemistry, Physics, Health Education, Catering & Craft Practice, Garment Making, Textile Trade, Marketing/Salesmanship, Cosmetology; or NTC/NBC credit passes or TCII Merit including English and Mathematics. UTME subjects: Biology/Agricultural Science and any two of Home Economics/Management, Economics, Chemistry, Physics.

Direct Entry: preliminary degree candidates from Benue State University only must pass at least five of six subjects at 50%; NCE use of English acceptable in lieu of 'O' Level English; 'A' Level pass in acceptable subjects; upper credit ND/HND or Diploma in Fashion and Clothing Management Education or Home Economics plus credit in two of Home Management, Clothing and Textiles, Food and Nutrition, Biology, Chemistry, Agricultural Science and Economics; NCE (Home Economics Education) merit with credit in four of the same; any other qualification considered appropriate by BSU. UTME: 'O' Level credit passes in English Language, Mathematics, Biology and any two of Home Management, Clothing and Textiles, Food and Nutrition, Chemistry, Agricultural Science and Economics at WASSCE/SSCE/GCE 'O' Level/NTC/NBC. UTME subjects: Biology, Chemistry, and any one of Mathematics, Physics, Economics, Agricultural Science.
UTME: 'O' Level credit passes in Chemistry, Mathematics, and any two of Food and Nutrition, Home Economics/Home Management, Clothing and Textile, Agricultural Science/Biology.
UTME: 'O' Level credit passes in Biology and Chemistry.
UTME: one (1) Science subject. UTME subjects: one Science subject and any other subjects.
UTME: 'O' Level credit pass in Chemistry.
UTME: five 'O' Level credit passes to include English Language, Mathematics, Biology or Chemistry and any two other subjects.
UTME subjects: Chemistry, Biology/Agricultural Science, and Mathematics/Physics.
UTME subjects: Biology or Agricultural Science and any two Science or Social Science subjects.
